meta.title: Tactical Briefing Boot
meta.description: A four-beat holographic mission-briefing opening: holographic command-table uplink, full-bleed theater map (procedural coastlines, latitude/longitude graticule, satellite data rails, long-ray data-node bursts, a magenta highlighted sector, a mission subtitle line), operator access / systems check, and a mission-start title. The map and HUD are drawn in code; Agnes generates only the terrain relief and holographic table plates. About 15 seconds, skippable, played once per application start.
